mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear, cold 26 degrees at the Verona Area High School with a waxing crescent moon visible in the sky.

The city is currently processing several development projects for the Plan Commission, including site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, while also posting public notices for upcoming elections.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow. Also, keep an eye out for Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow and various trivia nights starting Tuesday.
In a noteworthy call from October 25th, Verona police arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after discovering him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
If you are craving something sweet, head to Culver's today for the Mint Explosion flavor of the day; they open today at 10:00 AM.
